Graham Beasley then got another silver in the 100m to be followed by a win from Sean Baldock who dipped under 46secs for the second time this season and defeated a lacklustre Du'aine Ladejo.

Later Graham Beasley powered into a bend headwind to clock his season's best in the200 to be followed by Tim Benjamin emulating the win and gaining his season's best as he cruised to a fine B string victory in his first outing in Belgrave colours.
The top ten in our rankings showed a big change from previous years with only Spencer Barden, Graham Beasley, Kevin Brown and Julian Flynn of our big guns producing the goods.
